content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: Confidential Information means all proprietary information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._OBLIGATIONS_OF_RECEPTIVE_PARTY
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM_AND_TERMINATION
content_blocks.text: This agreement shall remain in effect until terminated by either party upon written notice.
